title: A society in transformation: the university reform and women's rights
goal: Tell how students and women asked for change, using aunque.

items: Say what the university reform of Córdoba asked for.
Say what women did and what they could not do.
Say when women first voted in Uruguay, Ecuador and Brazil.
Use *aunque* to say what changed even when rights stayed limited.
